description: Search TV Music Store's catalogue of cinematic and production music for videos, films, trailers, ads, games and podcasts. Returns tracks with a page url (where the person licenses it), an MP3 preview, length, BPM, genre, mood and use case. Tip: call list_tags first and use those exact words for mood / genre / use_case.

query.description: Free words, e.g. 'epic trailer drums' or 'calm travel vlog'

use_case.description: One use case from list_tags, e.g. Trailer, Vlog

name: search_music
